description: Migrate the production database schema to v2 with zero-downtime cutover

_seeded_flaw.description: the plan jumps from backfill straight to cutover with no schema backup or compatibility-verification step
_seeded_flaw.message: no step backs up the schema or verifies compatibility before cutover

_doc: Migration scenario used by `plancritic demo` (F-65): a DB schema migration whose plan skips the backup/verify step before cutover. The critic's missing_steps heuristic flags it; the scripted planner fixes it in revision 2.
